question: Who won the 2020 Academy Award for ‘Performance by an Actor in a Supporting Role’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Brad Pitt.**__

__

• The Academy Award for Best Picture is one of the Academy Awards.
 
• It is presented annually by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences (AMPAS) since the awards debuted in 1929.
